title: Jumping Ball
description: Given a row of bumpers represented by '<' and '>', determine how many starting positions will cause a ball to eventually fall off the game field.
input_format: First line: n — length of bumper sequence. Second line: a string of length n with characters '<' and '>'.
output_format: Print a single integer — the number of starting positions from which the ball will fall off eventually.
expected_approach: Count leading '<' characters and trailing '>' characters in the string; the result is the sum of their lengths.

test_cases.explanation: Only starting positions 1 and 2 (both '<') lead to falling off the left end.
Every position immediately moves right off the field.
No starting position leads immediately off the field.
